$comment: The version manifest @devdogsuga/devtools' dlx preflight fetches from this repo's `main` branch on every `pnpm devtools …` invocation (never `devtools-ci`, which pins an exact version on purpose — see Backstage's packages/devtools/src/repo/preflight.ts). `latest`: the newest published version; devtools nudges anyone behind it. `minimum`: the floor; devtools below this re-execs itself as `pnpm dlx @devdogsuga/devtools@<latest>`. Bump `latest` on every ordinary devtools release. Drop `minimum` to a hotfix version ONLY when an older devtools is actively broken (a bad publish, a bug that corrupts state) and every contributor needs to move off it within the ~10-minute cache window — see .github/CODEOWNERS for who reviews that. Keep both in sync with the exact version pinned in this repo's root package.json devDependency, which is CI's pinned copy and is bumped separately, through a reviewed PR, not by this manifest.
